verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover all three format families. Documents: research reports export as PDF or Word on any plan. Spreadsheets: tables export as CSV and Excel. Reference-manager files: the Library exports as .ris for Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote, and certain source tables export as RIS or BIB. The pricing page also lists RIS, CSV, BIB, PDF and DOCX export. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the export features, and clarity on which tables support RIS/BIB (systematic-review table export is limited to Pro and higher plans).
